concepts.def: Substance with no active drug — control in a trial
Neither patient nor doctor knows who got the drug
Test of safety/efficacy in healthy then ill volunteers
Variable raising chance of a disease

walkthroughs.body_html:
Step 1 preclinical: cells, tissues, animals.

Step 2: small clinical trial — low dose in healthy volunteers. Step 3: larger trial in patients with the disease. Double-blind avoids bias.

If 90 of 200 patients on the drug improve, improvement rate = 90 ÷ 200 × 100 = 45%.

Compare with placebo. If placebo gave 20%, drug effect is 25 percentage points.

BMI = mass ÷ height². 50 ÷ (1.6 × 1.6) = 50 ÷ 2.56 = 19.5 — healthy range.

BMI > 30 = obese; major risk for type 2 diabetes and heart disease.
